propositions: Recursive conftest glob in global_support caused all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest.py change, wasting 322.6 runner-minutes across 97 runs without increasing coverage.
Runtime tracing proved pytest loads only six ancestor conftests per test directory, not sibling fixture trees like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py.
Per-shard conftest support mapping reduces over-triggers by associating each non-root conftest only to shards whose configured tests actually load it.
Derived ancestry equality contract validates that per-shard support lists exactly match the ancestor conftests of their configured test paths, failing closed on missing or stale entries.
Unrelated nested conftest changes now select zero shards; each true ancestor conftest selects exactly its dependent mutation shards.
